response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM status_counts) AS share FROM status_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(s.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_amount_above_share FROM status_shares AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share;
